APTB_DESCRIPTION: Callsign
APTB_TEXT: The callsign must be encoded into the transmitter.

APTB_DESCRIPTION: No interference / no protection
APTB_TEXT: No interference shall be caused to any Radiocommunication station or service and no protection from interference by such stations or services shall be afforded.

APTB_DESCRIPTION: Repeater access
APTB_TEXT: Access to the repeater station must be provided on an unrestricted basis to any licensee in the service.

APTB_DESCRIPTION: Malfunction / interference
APTB_TEXT: In the event of a malfunction or interference being caused to other services, termination of transmissions must be promptly effected. Where access to the repeater is difficult, termination of transmissions must be achievable by remote switching.

APTB_DESCRIPTION: Charges/continuous service/transmission restriction
APTB_TEXT: 1. The station must produce a continuous service. 2. No charges may be imposed by the licensee or their agent for the use of the repeater facility. 3. No transmission shall be made in the absence of a received signal. The transmitter must not be able to lock-on due to a malfunction.
